_about: Freewheel prototype sounds. Pending: genny is not installed in the build container, so this spec waits here until someone renders it with python tools/render_sounds.py freewheel after moving it up to sound-specs/. Each bike has its own roll, freehub and pedal loops: the road bike a thin hiss, a fast light freehub tick and a smooth whirr, the BMX a chunky buzz, a loud slower clatter and a clanking chain. The game sets their pitch and volume from speed, so they stay steady loops. Hazards are short mono ticks the game places at the hazard and repeats faster as it nears: a woodblock tick for potholes and open doors, a low hard tick for curbs, a rising chirp for ramps. The car is a mono engine loop placed behind, beside and ahead. The door click is a sharp latch, the door open a creak. The act-now cue is a sharp double beep, used for nothing else. The turn chimes are two-note bells, falling for left and rising for right, placed on their side. The city bed is very quiet so it never masks a cue or speech. Music is a light plucked loop for the title and a short major chord for the finish.

sounds._about: Against the clock: the dry tick of a low clock, once a second under 15 seconds, twice a second in the last 5. A stopwatch click, brighter and shorter than the pothole's woodblock.
Car-free Sunday: a quiet morning, birdsong and a far church bell in place of the city.
Menu back: a soft lower ding.
Pause music: a soft synth cruise, the bike coasting.
